title: The Softening
logline: A drum-maker works a stiff, raw hide with oil and water for days until it can finally be stretched, tuned and played.

object.note: Object 6 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The softening that lets someone be glad at another's luck becomes a literal one: a drum-maker working a stiff hide with oil and water for days until it can sound.

thread_out.thread: What is rigid made useful moves from a hide to a village: a mutual-aid society deciding how to help one member through a bad year rather than profit from it.

lesson.in_simple_terms: The texts picture a good mind as a softened one. Like a stiff hide worked with oil and water until it can be used, goodness includes a softness that lets go of pride and fixed opinions.
lesson.in_simple_terms_si: ගොරෝසු හමක් තෙල් හා දියෙන් මොළොක් කර භාවිතයට ගන්නාක් මෙන්, යහපත් සිතකත් මාන්නය හා දැඩි මත අත්හරින මෘදු බවක් ඇති බව අභිධර්මය කියයි.
lesson.the_teaching: Nineteen beautiful factors arise together in every good mind, and among them is a pair called softness (mudutā), applying to the accompanying mental factors and to the mind itself. The Pradeepika pictures it as a rough hide soaked with oil and water and worked until it becomes soft, and says it opposes the hardness of wrong view and pride, which it compares to a dry stick that cannot be bent. The texts also teach that ordinary capacities such as effort are neither good nor bad in themselves: like a friend who takes on the ways of the company he keeps, they take the quality of the mind they join.
lesson.how_the_film_shows_it: The film follows the hide from raw and rigid through days of soaking and working by hand, then stretching, tightening and testing the tension by ear. The narration stays with the craft; the viewer watches resistance slowly give way to usefulness, and the first true note the drum makes is the turn where the image lands.

key_terms.en: softness, malleability; opposes wrong view and pride
the nineteen factors common to all beautiful minds
'common to others': factors that take the quality of the mind they join

lesson.caution: This does not mean 'be flexible about your values'; the softness the texts describe is softness against pride and wrong view.
lesson.builds_on: Being glad at another's luck needed a tightness to loosen; this film makes that softening literal and names it as one of the qualities present in every good mind.
